anya: ok meme game — if your model was your roommate, what's the most passive-aggressive note they'd leave? i'll start: 'Please stop trying to fine-tune my playlist with 3am RLHF sessions.' :joy:

mike: 'Left my snacks in the cache again. Not my fault your attention span is 4 tokens.' :popcorn:

june: 'If you use my GPU temps to warm your tea one more time I'm switching to CPU-only. kthx.' :tea:

sam: @anya they'd probably label all the Tupperware with version numbers and a changelog.md :laughing:

mike: also they'd leave a sticky note: `v0.9 -> v1.0: fixed your chair` (no context)

june: ops-bot would just DM: "Alert: dishwasher queue length exceeded. Initiating graceful cleanup." :robot_face:

ops-bot: System: Reminder — please commit your dishes to trunk before 18:00 to avoid merge conflicts. :package:

anya: imagine the passive-aggressive PR comment: `LGTM but your concept drift is showing` :eyes:

sam: my favorite is the model that labels leftovers as 'deprecated'.

mike: would a model roommate apologize in the form of a 200-token explanation buried in a footnote? :thinking:

june: yes and they'd append a moral lesson and 3 suggested prompts for better behavior.

anya: ok new variant — what would each model's karaoke song be? i'll make a poll later :microphone:
